summary: Register MoySklad as the second ERP reference provider using the official read-only JSON API for product assortment, stock-by-store and customer orders, adding only an additive ERP order-read SDK capability while keeping frozen Connector/Runtime roots and Core provider-neutral.

impacts.evidence: Connector account organization/workspace remain host-owned; provider code receives only the validated account/runtime and has no tenant persistence authority.
Committed API fixtures are synthetic. Bearer token bytes exist only inside SecretAccessor callbacks; raw remote bodies and transport errors are never persisted as evidence.
Task 016 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP endpoint or OpenAPI operation.
The provider is read-only and introduces no EventBus schema; Task 013 owns propagation metadata.

Frozen Connector/Runtime roots remain unchanged. Task 016 adds additive erp.orders.read/ERPOrderReader and corrects the shared ERP inventory projection to preserve exact signed balances documented by MoySklad; existing interfaces remain source-compatible.
Task 016 adds no migration; connector accounts, mappings, sync and reconciliation persistence already exist.

Provider code has no direct network/database/filesystem/process/Core/App authority. Fixed HTTPS host/path are host-mediated, gzip is requested, credentials are scoped bearer bytes, and meta hrefs are accepted only from the canonical MoySklad API entity prefix.
Manifest is strictly read-only and grants neither erp.catalog.write nor erp.orders.write.
Remote reads do not mutate business state; later sync application retains existing Task-003/030 obligations.
MoySklad product/order/store/state ids remain remote mapping keys, updated is opaque revision evidence, list cursors are bounded/fingerprinted, and Task 014 owns drift control.
All requests use a host-injected transport to fixed api.moysklad.ru; provider code imports no net package.
Auth/rate/service outcomes normalize to bounded SDK health/error states; manifest throttling is conservative relative to official limits and production SLO thresholds remain Task 066.
Suspend the connector account or remove the MoySklad provider route to stop reads; no database rollback is required.

Synthetic fixtures cover catalog, stock-by-store, orders, pagination including mid-row inventory resume, exact signed balances, malformed/duplicate/exponent response cases and the canonical Task-064 machine report passes all thirteen checks.
